archetypes.name: dyn-prefix-lints
archetypes.rationale: Composition matching and case-variant scanning are easy to under-specify at token boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect lint_lifecycle_prefix_literal composition contexts and lint_prefix_case_variant discovery. Confirm f-string, concat, and format matching use equality or space/colon boundaries without flagging BUGFIX-like suffixes. Confirm Markdown and residual Bash discovery fail closed on symlinks and malformed manifests, and that exact-case canonical tokens stay allowed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
